name: HubSpot
oneLiner: CRM with free tools and paid hubs; Marketing Hub runs from per-seat Starter to Professional, which adds contact tiers and a required onboarding fee.
summary: HubSpot sells marketing, sales, service, content, data and revenue software as separate hubs on one shared CRM database, with a free edition for up to two users. Marketing Hub Starter is priced per seat and can be paid month to month, while Professional and Enterprise start at a flat monthly base with seats included, charge more as marketing contacts grow, and require a 12-month commitment plus a one-time onboarding fee.
notFor: Solo operators who need SMS marketing (HubSpot sells it only with Professional or Enterprise)
Teams that want month-to-month billing on advanced automation (Professional needs a 12-month commitment)
Businesses outside the U.S. that need native marketing SMS
pros: Free tools for up to 2 users and 1,000 contacts, with no credit card required
Only marketing contacts are billed; non-marketing contacts are stored free up to 15 million total contacts
Starter can be paid month to month and carries no onboarding fee
List prices, contact tiers, add-ons and limits are published in a public Product & Services Catalog
The public price calculator shows the first-year cost, onboarding included, before any sales call
Marketing, sales, service, content and data hubs all run on the same Smart CRM contact database
cons: Professional and Enterprise charge a mandatory one-time onboarding fee on top of the subscription
Professional needs a 12-month commitment and Enterprise is billed annually only
Marketing SMS is sold only as an add-on to Professional or Enterprise, and only to U.S. customers
Marketing contact tiers can't be lowered until renewal, and going over a tier is billed immediately
Starter caps email automation at 10 automated actions, so multi-step workflows push teams to Professional
Every Core Seat is billed at the highest edition you own across any hub
